status: logical proposal and software-validated target; complete chip RTL/PPA pending

baseline.weight_stride: smallest stride >= packed row bytes and stride modulo 4 equals 2
baseline.write_policy: single byte per cycle; computation/transfer phases serialized
baseline.validity: one valid bit per byte; clear on reset/start/ena abort

larger_working_set.purpose: longer-K weight reuse; mapped area trade-off

transport.clock_domain: single synchronous clock; no CDC bridge or PLL
transport.reset: rst_n synchronous active-low, hold for >=2 rising edges
transport.ena_low: abort, clear control/validity, deassert outputs and output-enable

upstream: torch.export/Relax VM supported DAG; opt-in installed SGLang CPU Linear interposer

dependency_boundary.runtime: standalone C ABI and lightweight ISA codegen; no TVM import in serving adapter
